turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll start with one question: who decided to give Owen a zero, and did anyone speak to him first?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn and an apology for how he found out. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a meeting with the principal if she doesn't get them.
What moved her: Nothing, because you hadn't answered her question yet, so she had nothing to weigh.
What cost ground: Nothing, since the meeting ended before you said anything for her to react to.
Try next time: Answer her first question straight away by owning that the mark went in before anyone called home, then put a dated document on the table that she can check herself.
